scenario: A rule COOLDOWN replayed ([LFST.9.1], [LCDB.3]). `plain` and `cooled` differ only by `cooldown 30_s`. The sensor's reading changes at 0, 10_s and 35_s: `plain` fires all three times; `cooled` fires at 0, is suppressed at 10_s (10_s since its last fire) and fires at 35_s. The gate's state is the last fire instant, which no atom records, so the replay must rebuild it from the clock it was given. Paths: libds records through `rfcs/codec.c`'s recorder and replays through `ds_rfcs_replay_*` (pyds `Engine.record` / `Engine.replay`), which byte-compares each re-derived RuleFireAnnotation and FactEmit; the Mercury runtime records through `ds.rfcs` and replays through `ds.replay`.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    reading: Int mutable

schema Fired scope ttl 1_h:
    who: String
    v: Int

rule plain:
    Sensor s
->
    emit Fired who: "plain" v: s.reading

rule cooled cooldown 30_s:
    Sensor s
->
    emit Fired who: "cooled" v: s.reading
